categories.main_business_segments: Huapengfei Co., Ltd. primarily operates in comprehensive modern logistics services, including domestic integrated logistics, international logistics, supply chain management, and intelligent mobile services. The company offers standardized, one-stop global logistics products and customized supply chain solutions mainly for manufacturing clients and import-export trade entities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated logistics operations combining road transport, rail, sea, air, and multimodal transport. It utilizes information technology for logistics resource integration, GPS/Beidou tracking, risk control, and digital supply chain management. Huapengfei also develops proprietary large logistics systems to support seamless domestic and international logistics and supply chain integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturing enterprises, import-export traders, and high value-added industries such as new energy, new materials, and high-end equipment sectors. The company focuses on serving core manufacturing clients with customized logistics solutions and has expanded international logistics services along the Belt and Road routes, covering Central Asia, Russia, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in China’s South China, East China, Southwest, Central China, North China, Northeast, and Northwest regions, with significant revenue from South China. Internationally, the company has established subsidiaries and teams in Kazakhstan, Xinjiang, and key border hubs like Horgos and Alashankou, serving Central Asia, Russia, and European markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huapengfei operates primarily as a midstream and downstream logistics service provider, offering contract logistics, transportation, warehousing, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. It integrates upstream logistics resources through outsourcing and partnerships but does not engage in manufacturing or raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on digital transformation, cost control, and service quality enhancement. R&D efforts concentrate on developing a large logistics system to integrate domestic and international logistics, improving digital capabilities and operational transparency. It emphasizes innovation in supply chain solutions tailored to high-tech and emerging industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from logistics operations including transportation, warehousing, customs brokerage, and supply chain management. The company also earns income from investment returns, government subsidies, and occasional asset disposals, but product sales are not a primary revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huapengfei is positioned as a leading domestic contract logistics and supply chain management provider with competitive advantages in integrated multi-modal transport and international logistics along Belt and Road corridors. It faces competition from both domestic logistics firms and international logistics companies entering the Chinese market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 334 million, a 7.66% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 17.14 million, down 82.65%. Despite short-term profit decline, the company shows growth in domestic and international logistics segments after adjusting for discontinued subsidiaries, with ongoing investments in digital systems and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huapengfei emphasizes stable, efficient, and secure logistics services with customized, end-to-end supply chain solutions. Its differentiation lies in integrated multi-modal transport capabilities, digital tracking and risk management, strong financial credibility for timely payments, and a well-established brand reputation supported by certifications such as AEO and TIR.
